scenes.title: largest prime factor of 84
scenes.problem: Find the largest prime factor of 84. Show its prime factorisation.
actions: Place 84 as the factor-tree roots. A prime leaf has no smaller factors except one.
Split the next composite node: 84 = 2 × 42. Keep every earlier branch visible.
Split the next composite node: 42 = 2 × 21. Keep every earlier branch visible.
Split the next composite node: 21 = 3 × 7. Keep every earlier branch visible.
Read all prime leaves and multiply them back to the roots: 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7.
Select the largest prime leaf. The largest prime factor is 7. 7 divides 84 and is prime.
scenes.memo: 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7. Select the largest prime leaf in the factor tree. largest prime factor = 7. 7 is prime and divides 84.
scenes.misconception: Confusing common minimum powers for HCF with maximum powers for LCM, or treating 1 as prime.
